notes:
Company profile: Silverquarry builds a B2B search layer for mid-market SaaS customers (customer success + docs + contracts). Evaluating Redwood to replace an in-house embedding pipeline + Pinecone for retrieval.

Business drivers:
- Improve semantic recall for support and knowledge search across multi-format docs (pdf, html, slack).
- Reduce inference cost and latency during peak business hours; current infra spikes when daily batch indexing runs.
- Need predictable SLA for customer-facing search (SLO: <100ms end-to-end for top-5 results, 99th pctl <250ms).

Technical requirements / targets:
- Embedding throughput: sustained 120-200 reqs/sec for real-time ingestion; batch reindex jobs up to 1.5M docs/month (~6-8M vectors).
- Vector DB: primary integration with Pinecone and evaluation against FAISS on EBS (cost tradeoffs). Must support incremental upserts and TTL.
- Latency: embedding p50 <120ms, p95 <250ms in hosted test.
- Fallbacks: want routing to cheaper quantized model for non-critical queries.
- Data handling: tenant separation, opt-in data residency (US), audit logs and KMS for key management.

POC plan (current):
- Phase 1 (hosted API, 2 weeks): baseline embed quality + latency with Redwood hosted -> run 50k-sample semantic recall test vs current embedding vectors. Stress test to 200 qps for short window. (In progress: benchmark scripts in drive.)
- Phase 2 (dedicated trial, 1 week): large batch reindex (1M docs) to validate throughput and peak GPU utilization; test routing/fallback policy. (pending if hosted meets SLOs)
- Success criteria: recall lift >= 8% on top-5, embedding cost per vector below $0.0006, ingestion window for nightly batch <4 hrs.

Timeline / recent activity:
- 2026-02-11: Intro call w/ Maya + tech team (fireflies ff_2026-02-11_SQ-discovery).
- 2026-02-18: POC kickoff, shared scripts + sample dataset, agreed on metrics (fireflies ff_2026-02-18_POC-kickoff).
- 2026-02-24: Security questionnaire submitted; asked for SOC2 controls matrix and KMS integration doc. Drive: Security-Checklist.xlsx.
- 2026-02-25: Hosted ingest benchmark ran (p50 110ms, p95 240ms) — team flagged p95 volatility during batch windows.

Quotes / call notes:
- "We need predictable costs for scaling to thousands of tenants — surprised by egress with current vector provider." — VP Eng.
- AE notes: cost sensitivity medium-high; willingness to commit to Dedicated if SLA + price per vCPU/GPU clear.

Procurement / commercial:
- Initial estimate ARR target: $75k-$200k. Procurement wants 3 price bands: hosted, 12-mo Dedicated commit, 24-mo Dedicated with SLAs.

Open questions / blockers:
- SOC2 evidence and liability wording in contract (security team escalated).
- Need clearer migration story / tooling for moving vectors from Pinecone to Redwood-managed store or self-hosted FAISS fallback.
- Egress billing model when using hybrid vector DB (Redwood hosting embeddings + external DB).
